mentions.name: Parents Guide to AI
mentions.description: A website guide and blog that helps parents understand AI and answers common questions from family and friends, covering topics such as AI rollouts in schools, deepfakes, and how to respond when a kid's online behavior escalates from unfriendly to abusive or criminal.
mentions.problem: AI guidance for parents is underserved: there are many resources for when a kid is a victim of a deepfake, but little help for parents who know their kid is getting into trouble and escalating toward abusive or even criminal behavior.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://parentsguidetoai.ca

I spend all day working on AI related stuff at my day job, but more recently I have been getting lots of questions about AI from friends and family and that ramped up when the Vancouver school board announced they were rolling out Copilot across high schools.

I put together the guide, made a few iterations and published it and now I am getting more questions than ever and it's turned into a blog too.
